mapper.insert: INSERT INTO slack_workspace (team_id, team_name, bot_user_id, bot_token_enc, signing_secret_enc, installed_by_user_id) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{teamName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{botUserId}, #{botTokenEnc}, '', #{installedByUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT (team_id) DO UPDATE SET team_name = EXCLUDED.team_name, bot_user_id = EXCLUDED.bot_user_id, bot_token_enc = EXCLUDED.bot_token_enc, installed_by_user_id = EXCLUDED.installed_by_user_id, revoked_at = NULL
mapper.update: MERGE INTO slack_workspace t USING (SELECT #{teamId} AS tid FROM DUAL) s ON (t.team_id = s.tid) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.team_name = #{teamName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.bot_user_id = #{botUserId}, t.bot_token_enc = #{botTokenEnc}, t.installed_by_user_id = #{installedByUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, t.revoked_at = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (team_id, team_name, bot_user_id, bot_token_enc, signing_secret_enc, installed_by_user_id) VALUES (s.tid, #{teamName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{botUserId}, #{botTokenEnc}, NULL, #{installedByUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
